llm_suggested.rationale: Strategy is unprofitable (PF 0.92, -8R) with only 45% WR. Three key fixes: (1) Drop weight to 0.7 to deprioritize in ranking until performance improves. (2) Switch from 1/3/5min mix to 15min—RSI divergence on sub-5min charts generates excessive noise and false signals; higher TF produces more reliable swing divergences with cleaner structure. (3) Add EMA (trend filter) and volume (confirm hidden/regular divergence). With WR stuck below 50%, profitability requires asymmetric R targets—[1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 5.0] gives expected R:R ~2.0:1 which overcomes the 45% WR.
